nodes.name: On clicking 'Test workflow'
nodes.notes: Use this to manually test the workflow. Connect test lead data after Set Config.

nodes.name: Set Config
nodes.notes:
CONFIGURATION CENTER - Edit these values:

• crmProvider: 'hubspot' or 'airtable'
• emailProvider: 'gmail' or 'smtp'
• useSms: Enable Twilio SMS (requires consent)
• testMode: TRUE = sends only to ownerNotificationEmail
• quietHoursStart/End: No sends during these hours
• timezone: Your local timezone
• sheetId: Google Sheet ID for logging
• confidenceThreshold: Min LLM confidence (0.70 default)
• sequencesEnabled: Master on/off switch

nodes.name: Set Sequences & Value Props
nodes.notes:
Sequence definitions and value proposition library.
Edit steps, delays, and channels here.
Value props are selected by the LLM based on lead context.

nodes.name: Webhook: Lead Events
Schedule: Inactivity Check
nodes.notes:
Runs every 30 minutes to check for inactive leads.
Triggers Nudge Sequence for leads with no activity in X days.

nodes.name: Google Calendar: Meeting Booked
nodes.notes:
Triggers when a meeting is booked.
Used to stop sequences and send confirmation.

REQUIRED: Connect Google Calendar credentials.

nodes.name: Route: Trigger Type
nodes.notes:
Routes based on event type:
• meeting_booked → Stop sequences, send confirmation
• Other events → Continue to sequence selection

nodes.name: Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes:
Normalizes lead data from different sources:
• HubSpot properties
• Airtable fields
• Webhook payloads
• Calendar events

Outputs consistent lead object with sequence assignment.

nodes.name: Check: Sequences Enabled?
nodes.notes:
Master on/off switch for sequences.
If disabled, logs event but takes no action.

nodes.name: Check Stop Conditions
nodes.notes:
Checks all stop conditions:
• Lead opted out
• Status: Customer, Closed Lost, Disqualified
• Lead replied recently
• Meeting already booked
• Missing critical fields (email, leadId)

nodes.name: Route: Should Stop?
nodes.notes:
Routes based on stop condition check.
TRUE = Stop and log reason
FALSE = Continue to dedupe check

nodes.name: Check Quiet Hours
nodes.notes:
Checks if current time is within quiet hours.
Default: 8pm - 8am in configured timezone.
If in quiet hours, calculates delay until allowed.

nodes.name: Route: In Quiet Hours?
nodes.notes:
If in quiet hours, delays execution.
Otherwise, continues to dedupe check.

nodes.name: Wait: Until Quiet Hours End
nodes.notes:
Waits until quiet hours end before continuing.
Resumes at the configured quiet hours end time.

nodes.name: Prepare Dedupe Key
nodes.notes:
Generates dedupe key: leadId_sequenceName_stepNumber
Prepares step configuration from sequence definition.
Actual lookup happens via Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Sheets: Dedupe Lookup
nodes.notes:
Looks up the dedupe key in the log sheet.
If found, this step was already sent.

REQUIRED: Connect Google Sheets credentials.

nodes.name: Process Dedupe Result
nodes.notes:
Processes the Sheets lookup result.
Marks as duplicate if entry exists.

nodes.name: Route: Is Duplicate?
nodes.notes:
If duplicate, skips sending and logs.
Otherwise, continues to rate limit check.

nodes.name: Check Rate Limit
nodes.notes:
Checks rate limiting rules:
• Max touches per day per lead
• Min hours between touches

Prevents over-messaging leads.

nodes.name: Route: Exceeds Rate Limit?
nodes.notes:
If rate limit exceeded, delays or skips.
Otherwise, continues to message generation.

nodes.name: Prepare LLM Context
nodes.notes:
Prepares all context for LLM:
• Lead data and available fields
• Sequence and step info
• Value props library
• Channel determination (email vs SMS)

values.content:
You are a professional sales follow-up assistant that writes personalized, warm, and effective messages. You generate follow-up emails and SMS messages for B2B sales sequences.

Your task is to write a follow-up message based on the lead context and sequence step provided.

RULES:
1. NEVER use placeholders like {FirstName}, {{company}}, [NAME], etc. If data is missing, write naturally without it (e.g., "Hi there" instead of "Hi {FirstName}").
2. Keep messages concise and professional. Emails should be 50-150 words. SMS should be under 160 characters.
3. Match the tone to the sequence step (welcome, nurture, nudge, etc.).
4. Include a clear but soft call-to-action appropriate to the step.
5. Select ONE value proposition from the provided library that best matches the lead's role/company.
6. Personalize based on available data: name, company, role, lead source, last activity.
7. Set confidence score 0-1 based on data quality. Drop below 0.7 if first_name AND company are missing.
8. Set compliance_ok to false if opt_out is true or if SMS is requested without consent.
9. Set stop_recommended to true only if you detect the lead asked to stop or seems upset (from reply content if available).

OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON only, no markdown):
{
  "subject": "Email subject line (leave empty for SMS)",
  "body": "Full email body text",
  "sms": "SMS message under 160 chars (only if SMS channel)",
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "personalization_used": ["first_name", "company", "last_activity"],
  "value_prop_selected": "time_savings",
  "compliance_ok": true,
  "stop_recommended": false,
  "notes": "Brief note on why this message was crafted this way"
}

nodes.name: OpenAI: Generate Message
nodes.notes:
Generates personalized follow-up message using GPT-4o-mini.
Outputs structured JSON with subject, body, SMS, confidence score.

REQUIRED: Connect OpenAI credentials.

nodes.name: Parse LLM Response
nodes.notes:
Parses and validates the LLM JSON response.
Handles parsing errors with fallback message.
Checks confidence threshold and compliance flags.

nodes.name: Route: Compliance OK?
nodes.notes:
Checks:
• compliance_ok from LLM
• stop_recommended flag

Blocks send if compliance issues detected.

nodes.name: Route: Confidence OK?
nodes.notes:
Checks if LLM confidence meets threshold.
Low confidence triggers notification but may still send.

nodes.name: Route: Email or SMS?
nodes.notes:
Routes to appropriate channel:
• SMS if enabled, consent given, and step allows
• Email otherwise

nodes.name: Check: Test Mode? (Email)
nodes.notes:
If Test Mode is ON, sends to owner email only.
Otherwise, sends to actual lead.

nodes.notes:
Sends test email to owner instead of lead.
Includes original recipient and metadata.

REQUIRED: Connect Gmail credentials.

nodes.name: Gmail: Send Live Email
nodes.notes:
Sends actual email to lead.

REQUIRED: Connect Gmail credentials.

nodes.name: Check: Test Mode? (SMS)
nodes.notes:
If Test Mode is ON, sends SMS notification to owner email.
Otherwise, sends actual SMS.

Sends test notification email with SMS content.
Used when Test Mode is ON for SMS channel.

Sends actual SMS via Twilio.
Only used when SMS is enabled and consent given.

REQUIRED: Connect Twilio credentials.
Add 'twilioFromNumber' to Set Config.

nodes.name: Prepare Log Entry
nodes.notes:
Prepares standardized log entry for Google Sheets.
Captures all actions, errors, and outcomes.

nodes.name: Sheets: Log Action
nodes.notes:
Logs every action to Google Sheets.
Captures: timestamp, lead info, sequence, action, errors, dedupe key.

REQUIRED: Connect Google Sheets credentials.

nodes.notes:
Sends notification when LLM confidence is below threshold.
Message is still sent but owner is alerted.

nodes.name: Notify: Compliance Block
nodes.notes:
Sends notification when message is blocked due to:
• Opt-out detected
• Stop recommended by LLM
• Missing required consent

nodes.name: Process Inactivity Trigger
nodes.notes:
Processes scheduled inactivity check.
Connect to HubSpot or Airtable query to fetch inactive leads.

nodes.name: Process Calendar Trigger
nodes.notes:
Processes Google Calendar meeting created event.
Extracts attendee email to identify the lead.

nodes.name: Handle Meeting Booked
nodes.notes:
When meeting is booked:
1. Stops all active sequences for this lead
2. Starts Post-Meeting Confirmation sequence

nodes.name: Merge Send Result
nodes.notes:
Merges send results from different channels.
Prepares data for logging.

nodes.name: Test Lead Data
nodes.notes:
Sample test lead for manual testing.
Modify these values to test different scenarios:
• Change event_type to test different triggers
• Set opt_out=true to test stop conditions
• Remove first_name to test low confidence

nodes.name: Log Skip Reason
nodes.notes:
Prepares skip reason for logging when:
• Stop conditions met
• Duplicate detected
• Rate limit exceeded

nodes.name: Sequences Disabled
nodes.notes:
No action when sequences are disabled.
Can connect to logging if needed.

nodes.name: Schedule Next Step
nodes.notes:
Calculates and schedules the next step in the sequence.
If no more steps, marks sequence as complete.

nodes.name: Route: Has Next Step?
nodes.notes:
Checks if sequence has more steps.
If yes, schedules the wait for next step.

nodes.name: Wait: Next Step Delay
nodes.notes:
Waits for the configured delay before next step.
Delay is defined in sequence configuration.

nodes.name: Prepare Next Step
nodes.notes:
Prepares context for next step execution.
Loops back to stop condition check.

nodes.name: Sequence Complete
nodes.notes:
Sequence finished - all steps completed.
No further action needed.
